# Nexus AI OS

> Enterprise Intelligence Operating System — an executive AI platform for live KPIs, decision intelligence, crisis management, and execution tracking across the entire enterprise.

Nexus AI OS unifies enterprise data (intelligence events, alerts, KPIs, governance, transformation programs, business outcomes) into a single executive operating system with multilingual AI assistants grounded in real organizational data.

## Core capabilities
- Executive Cockpit — live financial, operational and risk signals
- Decision Intelligence — AI recommendations grounded in enterprise data (RAG)
- Execution Engine — boardroom decision → task tracking
- Boardroom Mode — strategic presentation surface
- ARIA voice copilot — bilingual (AR/EN) with ElevenLabs STT/TTS

## AI providers
ARIA uses OpenRouter as a unified gateway across OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), and Google (Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro). Voice via ElevenLabs.
